verdict.rationale: cubic ships a built-in AI assistant you can hand tasks to. You can mention it in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews and request fixes. "Fix with cubic" generates a fix and pushes it to the PR branch, and a context-aware chat sidebar supports "Add to AI chat" on selected code and "tour this PR" walkthroughs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat and fix-delegation features, delegation that goes beyond review and fix tasks, and current first-party docs for the chat sidebar (its page sits under an archive path).
